The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: User Management ASIM parser for CrowdStrike Falcon Data Replicator
properties.query:
CrowdStrike_User_Events_CL
| where not(disabled)
| where event_simpleName in ("UserAccountCreated", "UserAccountDeleted", "UserAccountAddedToGroup")
| extend
    EventType = case(
        event_simpleName == "UserAccountCreated", "UserCreated",
        event_simpleName == "UserAccountDeleted", "UserDeleted",
        "UserAddedToGroup"),
    EventStartTime = coalesce(unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(timestamp), TimeGenerated),
    TargetUsernameType = case(
        isempty(UserName), "",
        UserName startswith "CN=", "DN",
        UserName contains "@", "UPN",
        UserName contains "\\", "Windows",
        "Simple"),
    TargetUserId = iff(DomainSid startswith "S-1-" and isnotnull(tolong(UserRid)), strcat(DomainSid, "-", UserRid), ""),
    GroupId = iff(event_simpleName == "UserAccountAddedToGroup" and DomainSid startswith "S-1-" and isnotnull(tolong(GroupRid)), strcat(DomainSid, "-", GroupRid), ""),
    DvcOs = case(event_platform == "Win", "Windows", event_platform == "Mac", "macOS", event_platform == "Lin", "Linux", ""),
    AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
        "SourceAdditionalFields", AdditionalFields,
        "name", name,
        "ConfigBuild", ConfigBuild,
        "ConfigStateHash", ConfigStateHash,
        "ContextTimeStamp", ContextTimeStamp,
        "ContextProcessId", ContextProcessId,
        "ContextThreadId", ContextThreadId,
        "BoundingLimitCount", BoundingLimitCount,
        "BoundingLimitDuration", BoundingLimitDuration,
        "Entitlements", Entitlements,
        "EffectiveTransmissionClass", EffectiveTransmissionClass,
        "OciContainerId", OciContainerId,
        "TreeId", TreeId,
        "UserRid", UserRid,
        "GroupRid", GroupRid,
        "InterfaceVersion", InterfaceVersion,
        "RpcClientThreadId", RpcClientThreadId,
        "RpcOpNum", RpcOpNum,
        "InterfaceGuid", InterfaceGuid,
        "RpcClientProcessId", RpcClientProcessId,
        "RpcNestingLevel", RpcNestingLevel,
        "event_platform", event_platform), dynamic({}))
| project-rename
    EventOriginalType = event_simpleName,
    EventOriginalUid = CrowdStrikeId,
    TargetUsername = UserName,
    TargetUserScopeId = DomainSid,
    DvcIpAddr = aip,
    DvcId = aid,
    DvcScopeId = cid
| extend
    EventEndTime = EventStartTime,
    EventCount = int(1),
    EventResult = "Success",
    EventSeverity = "Informational",
    EventVendor = "CrowdStrike",
    EventProduct = "Falcon Data Replicator",
    EventSchema = "UserManagement",
    EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
    EventUid = EventOriginalUid,
    Dvc = coalesce(DvcId, DvcIpAddr),
    DvcIdType = iff(isnotempty(DvcId), "Other", ""),
    TargetUserIdType = iff(isnotempty(TargetUserId), "SID", ""),
    TargetUserSid = TargetUserId,
    GroupIdType = iff(isnotempty(GroupId), "SID", ""),
    ActorUsername = "",
    ActorUsernameType = "",
    ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
    ActorUserEntityKey = "",
    ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
    TargetUserEntityKey = "",
    TargetUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
    SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
    DvcEntityKey = "",
    AdditionalEntities = dynamic([])
| extend User = ActorUsername
| project
    TimeGenerated, Type,
    EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventCount, EventType, EventResult,
    EventSeverity, EventVendor, EventProduct, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion,
    EventOriginalType, EventOriginalUid, EventUid,
    Dvc, DvcIpAddr, DvcId, DvcIdType, DvcScopeId, DvcOs,
    ActorUsername, ActorUsernameType, User,
    TargetUsername, TargetUsernameType, TargetUserId, TargetUserIdType,
    TargetUserSid, TargetUserScopeId, GroupId, GroupIdType,
    ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds,
    TargetUserEntityKey, TargetUserAdditionalIds, SrcSystemEntityKey,
    DvcEntityKey, AdditionalEntities, AdditionalFields
